claim: Under the Sakai non-generic intersection form for PIII(D_6) on Pic(X) of rank 10, there exists an integer embedding of 7 simple roots alpha_0,...,alpha_6 with self-intersection -2, orthogonal to -K_X, whose pairwise Gram matrix is the symmetric D_6^{(1)} Cartan form with the two-fork topology. Whether the embedding matches the predecessor cycle's alpha_0,...,alpha_6 or differs is recorded as part of the claim, not pre-asserted.

verification_criteria.primary_source_sections: sec.3.3 eq (3.26) for the intersection form; sec.8.2.19 eq (8.98), (8.100), (8.101) for the canonical D_6^{(1)} simple roots delta_i

halt_conditions: HALTED_REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE: Sakai 2001 sec.8 and KNY 2017 sec.4 both unretrievable or ambiguously parsed
HALTED_NUMERICAL_SIGNATURE_AMBIGUOUS: any eigenvalue within 1e-9 of zero
HALTED_SEARCH_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: constraint search > 30 min wall-clock at max_coef=2
output_hash_scope: utf-8 stdout of `python sakai_d6/surface.py --verify-lattice` after Sakai form added; whitespace-sensitive
output_hash_note: see claims.jsonl for the canonical short-form AEAL line
